title: Annotatio IV §.XXI close: prayers and after-warning — Spirit feeds souls with Lord’s body and blood — stop before next §
pass_a_gloss: Finally, after the prayers are finished, when we Communicants all in common are gravely warned: That we should not cling with our hearts to the outward Bread and Wine; But ground our hearts and Faith on the Word of Promise: And not doubt that we are as truly, through the working of the Holy Spirit, fed and given to drink with the LORD’s Body and Blood at our souls as we receive the holy Bread and Drink in His remembrance — i.e. that we should not adhere with our hearts and minds to bread and wine, the external symbols, but keep minds and Faith fixed on the Words of Promise, doubting nothing that we are no less truly, by the Holy Spirit’s operation, fed and given to drink as to our souls with the Lord Savior’s very own body and blood than we receive the consecrated bread and drink in remembrance of Christ.
pass_b_english: After the prayers, communicants are warned: do not cling to outward bread and wine; ground heart and faith on the Word of Promise.

Doubt not that by the Spirit’s working we are as truly fed and given drink at our souls with the Lord’s Body and Blood as we receive the holy bread and cup in His remembrance. Stop before the next § (spiritual-presence modes digression).
source_text: Denique, post preces finitas, quando Communicantes in universum omnes graviter monemur: Daß wir mit unseren Herzen nicht an dem äusserlichen Brodt und Wein hafften sollen; Sondern unsere Herzen und Glauben gründen auff das Wort der Verheissung: Und nicht zweiffeln / daß wir so warhafftig / durch die Wirckung des Heiligen Geistes / mit des HERRN Leib und Blut / an unseren Seelen, gespeiset und getränket werden / als wir das heilige Brodt und Tranck zu seiner Gedächtniß empfangen. i. e. ne cordibus nostris animisque pani & vino, externis symbolis adhærescamus, sed mentes Fidemque in Verbis Promissionis defixas habeamus, nulli dubitantes, nos non minus verè, per operationem Spiritûs S. ipsissimo Domini Salvatoris corpore & sanguine, quà animas nostras, escari potarique, quàm panem consecratum potumque in commemorationem Christi accipimus.
notes: After: promise-word not external symbols; stop.
